verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents customizing grouping per exception by changing the error class, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint. That lets a developer force future errors to group together or apart, which is a code-level workaround rather than direct merge/split of issues. Automatic grouping of identical errors is documented and praised by users, but nothing shows triage-time actions on existing issues. missing for 10: UI/API action to merge existing duplicate issues, ability to split an already-collapsed issue retroactively, independent hands-on corroboration of grouping correction.
